description: This Java source file defines the TestsGroupingFilter class, which extends JUnit's Filter class to filter out tests based on grouping logic. It includes methods for adding filters to test runners using system properties or explicit parameters, and implements logic to determine if a test should run based on hashing strategies and group indices.

classes.name: TestsGroupingFilter
classes.description: A JUnit filter that filters tests based on grouping logic, using hashing strategies to determine test group membership.

methods.description: Adds a TestsGroupingFilter to a test runner using system properties for configuration.

methods.name: addTestsGroupingFilterToRunner
methods.description: Adds a TestsGroupingFilter to a test runner with specified hashing strategy, group count, and group to execute.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines if a test description should be run based on its group assignment.

methods.name: getGroupNumberFor
methods.description: Calculates the group number for a test description using the hashing strategy.

methods.description: Provides a description of the filter, indicating which group of tests it will execute.
